parameters.name: AgentDisplayName
parameters.description: The display name of the Agent.

parameters.name: AgentHost
parameters.description: The host address of the Agent.

parameters.name: AgentId
parameters.description: The Agent ID, which is uniformly assigned by CNNIC after real-name verification. The AgentID serves as the unique identifier that binds the Agent to the verified registrant.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return in this request.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next query.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The current page number. The start value is 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size for the paging query.
